p1_to_packages2_4.decision: Packages 2-4 and later Package 5 evidence cover changed event storage, allocation reporting, adapter and maximum-LOAD paths; the recorded physical-hour and mode results remain bound to their original images.

packages2_4_to_current.decision: The change transfers decoded request ownership and lowers duplicated maximum-LOAD memory demand. Package 5 physically covers the affected current-image LOAD, RF, overload, retention and reclamation paths; timeout, USB parser/output, TLS and RF timing mechanisms are unchanged.

candidate_to_package6_head.decision: Post-candidate changes are documentation, host-test registration, auditors and hardware fixtures; firmware identity remains 2b25ca05c270.

JOB-MAX.applicability: Atomic boundaries and three physical hours retain their recorded identities; Package 1 and current-image Package 5 cover maximum-event admission, execution and changed memory behavior.

WTP-MAX.applicability: Package 1 proves the exact payload boundary under RF; the later ownership transfer reduces copying and Package 5 verifies the affected current-image maximum-event LOAD path.

HTTP-MAX.applicability: The HTTP size boundary and authentication logic are unchanged; current-image Package 5 covers the affected memory interaction and authenticated recovery.

COMBINED.applicability: Package 2 proves supported overlap and bounded overload; Package 5 repeats the affected bounded-overload path three times on the current image and boot.

TLS-SLOW.applicability: TLS handshake deadlines are unchanged; Package 5 supplies current-image authenticated positive controls and allocation guards.

TLS-FAIL.applicability: Failed-alert lifetime paths and TLS implementation are unchanged; current-image positive recovery remains authenticated.

SLOT.applicability: Connection-slot and pending-expiry code is unchanged; Package 5 supplies current-image TLS reuse and recovery.

HTTP-PARTIAL.applicability: Partial-header/body and stalled writer/reader mechanisms are unchanged; current-image HTTP overload and recovery cover the changed allocation interaction.

PROGRESS.applicability: The 30-second drained and five-second input/output progress mechanisms are unchanged; current-image full LOAD completion and authenticated reuse cover the moved request lifetime.

USB.applicability: The later change occurs after complete frame decode and does not change USB parsing, output buffering or DTR handling; current-image Package 5 verifies the shared service LOAD lifetime.

TLS-VALID.applicability: Package 5 repeatedly authenticates WTP and HTTP on the selected candidate and recovers after overload and expiry.

BROWSER-MAX.applicability: The accepted browser source blob and file/message/progress logic are unchanged; Package 3 covers the allocation path and Package 5 covers the current service lifetime.

RETAINED.applicability: Package 5 proves current-image replay/session/terminal capacities, LRU behavior and real TTL expiry without promoting failed packets.

RECLAIM.applicability: Three equivalent current-image same-boot cycles have an eight-byte post spread, no monotonic growth and valid reserve/recovery.

FEATURE.1.resolution: Compiler limits and worst-complexity vectors remain unchanged and deterministic.

FEATURE.2.resolution: Duration arithmetic and exact/over-3600-second boundaries remain unchanged.

FEATURE.3.resolution: Packages 1, 2 and 5 cover the changed maximum-event and per-path memory behavior

FEATURE.4.resolution: QRSS, FSKCW and DFCW physical hours retain their original identities; no later RF worker/PIO timing change invalidates them.

FEATURE.5.resolution: Controller/lifecycle Group 1 remains closed with its historical observation failures preserved.

FEATURE.6.resolution: WSPR framing, advertised limits, atomic jobs and fixed local buffers remain unchanged.

FEATURE.7.resolution: Packages 2 and 5 cover shared-storage lifetime, expiry and equivalent-cycle reuse
